objective_and_hypothesis.justification: This matches the score-3 description: the study states a testable antiviral-screening objective, then examines mechanism, animal efficacy, and resistance, with rationale from prior broad-spectrum antiviral evidence and the absence of OROV treatment options.
objective_and_hypothesis.quote: We therefore assembled a panel of antiviral drugs and assessed their potential effect on OROV replication.

public_health_relevance.justification: This matches the score-3 description because it concerns an active, documented Central and South American OROV outbreak and explicitly cites a PAHO epidemiological alert regarding vertical transmission, alongside fatalities and congenital outcomes.
public_health_relevance.quote: In July 2024, the Pan American Health Organization issued an epidemiological alert about the potential of vertical transmission of OROV

study_design_rigor.justification: This matches the score-3 description: the paper provides detailed cell, virus, dosing, animal, RT-qPCR, polymerase-assay, sequencing, and statistical methods; it validates findings across cell assays, an in-vitro polymerase system, two animal models, histology/RNAscope, and resistance selection. It also states that source data are provided.
study_design_rigor.quote: All data generated and analyzed in this paper are included in this article.

results_and_conclusion.justification: Figures 1–2 agree with the surrounding text for the reported EC90 values (0.17 µM in A549 and 0.24 µM in JEG-3) and the 3% nine-mer/232% three-mer polymerase-product findings; Figure 7 reports integer sequencing-coverages rather than fractional discrete counts. However, the Results reports five mice per prophylactic group, whereas Figure 3 and the Methods report eight, an internal reporting inconsistency that fits the score-2 description rather than fully internally consistent score 3.
results_and_conclusion.quote: randomly assigned into five groups (n = 5 per group)

references.justification: The references are predominantly peer-reviewed and span foundational OROV/Peribunyaviridae work, current OROV epidemiology and outbreaks, antiviral studies, structural-polymerase research, and relevant analytical methods; relevant official PAHO alerts and one identified preprint on Boltz-2 are also included. No reference is clearly unrelated, although references 27 and 39 are duplicates, as are references 29 and 48.
references.quote: 4’-Fluorouridine is an oral antiviral that blocks respiratory syncytial virus and SARS-CoV-2 replication.
